results.title: Shah invites Modi to visit Nepal, welcomes Indian investors
results.content: At a joint press conference in New Delhi, Nepal’s prime minister says the two countries have embarked on a development partnership as they launch the Ayodhya-Janakpur train service.

results.title: Nepal and India sign eight MoUs on cooperation in multiple sectors
results.content: Agreements cover forensic science, police training, civil service capacity building, satellite communications, health, urban development and traditional medicine.

results.title: Shah-Modi bilateral talks conclude in New Delhi
results.content: Senior ministers, security officials and top diplomats from both countries take part in the high-level discussions during the Nepali prime minister’s state visit to India.

results.title: Shah says compassion is ultimate strength in tribute to Gandhi
results.content: In a message at Raj Ghat, Nepal’s prime minister draws a parallel between Gandhi’s legacy and the values of Buddha, while reaffirming Nepal’s commitment to its enduring ties with India.

results.title: Indian investors eye expansion in Nepal as Kathmandu courts fresh capital
results.content: Finance Minister Swarnim Wagle urges Indian businesses to invest in technology, hydropower and connectivity, while the two countries’ private sectors agree to cooperate on flood recovery.

results.title: Q&A: MCC officials on opening the gates of Lord’s and beyond for Nepal
results.content: In an exclusive interview, MCC administrators, Robert Lawson and Rob Lynch, reflect on the magic of the Home of Cricket, the rise of Associate nations, and why June’s tour is just the beginning for Nepal.

results.title: India likely to announce $1.5 billion package for Nepal, air-route deal under discussion
results.content: New Delhi hints at a ‘surprise’ announcement by Modi as PM Shah begins his first state visit; Nepal has sought $2 billion in grants and lines of credit.

results.title: Nepal register their 50th win in their 100th ODI
results.content: The Rhinos were playing their 100th ODI when they faced the UAE in the Asia Cup Rising Stars on Sunday. Nepal won it by six wickets.

results.title: Jaishankar meets Nepal PM Shah as state visit begins
results.content: The Nepali prime minister, who arrived in New Delhi on Sunday, is scheduled to hold talks with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and meet President Droupadi Murmu on Monday.

results.title: Nepal bounce back with six-wicket win over UAE
results.content: Sandeep Lamichhane and Kushal Bhurtel take three wickets each before Bhurtel's half-century guides Nepal to their first victory in the Asia Cup Rising Stars.

results.title: Shah leaves for India visit with $2bn financial proposal, air access on agenda
results.content: New Delhi has responded positively to Nepal’s proposal for grants and lines of credit, but the two sides have yet to agree on an additional air entry route through Indian airspace.

results.title: Police open organised-crime probe into 21.75kg gold seizure
results.content: Investigators are tracing the suspected route from Hong Kong to India and looking for local accomplices after three Chinese nationals were arrested in Kathmandu.

results.title: EU film festival opens in Kathmandu, discussing forbidden films and changing perceptions
results.content: The two-day festival combines European and Nepali film screenings with conversations about censorship, representation and the pressures shaping Nepali cinema.
